framework: HOEOS G4 R4 Four-Valued Status Model

precedenceRules.condition: Required evidence or prerequisites are missing, inaccessible, malformed, empty, or cannot be safely evaluated.
A mandatory test or check was not executed (e.g. exit code = -1 or reported status = NOT_RUN / SKIPPED).
Required checks executed and at least one assertion or integrity check failed (e.g. process exit != 0, assertions failed, mark count <= 0, offset invariant violated).
Every mandatory check executed, all required evidence is valid, all assertions passed, and all required process exits and hash checks succeeded.

g4CertificationStatusNotice: G4 verification-engine certification remains NOT CERTIFIED until independent execution without injected fixtures is demonstrated.
